notes.title: The Soul: about the project, genre, setting
notes.content:
[h2]About the project[/h2]
We are creating the project together with RedStarGames studio. Our acquaintance happened in 2023 at the IGROPROM exhibition. Two brothers were creating a project on Unreal Engine 5, which according to all copyright laws was impossible to monetize without a license. That is, they worked for the sake of their business, gaining experience and for fun.

This is how the collaboration of Antelus Games and RedStarGames took place. And what will come out of it, you will find out soon, together with the release of The Soul project in 2025.


[h2]Genre[/h2]
Action-adventure from the 3rd person.

[h2]Setting[/h2]
Alternate modernity with a touch of mysticism, where monsters lurk among humans.

[i]"It all started with one session with patient #17.
He asked me to look into the reasons for his erratic decision making and wanted to consult a psychologist. My usual conversations with him intrigued me. He talked about arguing with himself. About how every time a choice presents itself in life, his inner self contradicts his desires.
Finding no answers, I decided to calm him down and put him into a hypnotic sleep. It was then that the veil of another world began to open to me."

Excerpt from Marcos Miller's notes
[/i]
